subject: Quick session to walk through your benchmark report
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@datapulse.io>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick session to walk through your benchmark report

Hi Alex,

Thanks for downloading the benchmark report last week — glad it was helpful. I pulled a short one-page summary with the parts that looked most relevant to DataPulse (attached). Would you be open to a brief 30-minute walkthrough so we can: 

- highlight where the report points to latency/cost hot spots,
- sketch a quick routing/batching approach that would reduce token spend, and
- surface any integration concerns for your infra team.

I have a couple 30-minute windows this week if any work for you:
- Wed Apr 7, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Thu Apr 8, 13:30–14:00 PT
- Fri Apr 9, 09:00–09:30 PT

Or you can pick something on my calendar: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij

I attached a short summary (report-summary.pdf) that calls out 3 pages I recommend we review first. If you prefer, I can loop in Marissa (AE) or Karthik (solutions lead) depending on whether you want a product or technical-focused run.

Thanks — looking forward to connecting,

— Hannah Schmitt
SDR, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachment: report-summary.pdf

From: Alex Moreno <alex@datapulse.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick session to walk through your benchmark report

Hi Hannah,

Thanks — the one-pager is useful. I downloaded the full benchmark and shared it with our ML infra lead. We'd like a session that includes one of your technical folks to validate the KV-cache / batching assumptions in section 2.

Your Wed 10am slot conflicts with an internal sprint review. Could we do Thu Apr 8 at 15:00 PT instead? If not, Fri morning works but we prefer Thu.

Also, can you confirm whether Redwood supports private VPC deployment for inference (our compliance team will ask)?

Best,
Alex
Alex Moreno
Head of ML Infrastructure, DataPulse
alex@datapulse.io
